headline: 955 hospitalized in 24 hours as 2 die of dengue across Bangladesh
summary: Health authorities report a surge in admissions as the total number of hospitalizations this year reaches over 70,000.
details: According to the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), two people died of dengue in the last 24 hours.
A total of 955 patients were admitted to hospitals across the country during the same period.

The admissions were distributed across various regions: 246 in Chattogram, 241 outside Dhaka city, 113 in Dhaka South City Corporation, 76 in Dhaka North City Corporation, 130 in Khulna, 44 in Barishal, 44 in Rangpur, 37 in Mymensingh, and 4 in Sylhet.
As of September 25, a total of 70,104 people have been hospitalized for dengue this year.
Of those, 64,827 patients have recovered and been discharged from the hospital.
Currently, 953 patients remain under medical treatment in hospitals across the country.
caption:

The admissions were distributed across various regions: 246 in Chattogram, 241 outside Dhaka city, 113 in Dhaka South City Corporation, 76 in Dhaka North City Corporation, 130 in Khulna, 44 in Barishal, 44 in Rangpur, 37 in Mymensingh, and 4 in Sylhet.

As of September 25, a total of 70,104 people have been hospitalized for dengue this year.

Of those, 64,827 patients have recovered and been discharged from the hospital.

Currently, 953 patients remain under medical treatment in hospitals across the country.

headline_marked: Malaysia 3, Bangladesh 0: [[Bangladesh thumped 3-0 by Malaysia]] in ASEAN Cup opener
headline: Malaysia 3, Bangladesh 0: Bangladesh thumped 3-0 by Malaysia in ASEAN Cup opener
summary: The national team struggled to create meaningful chances as they suffered a heavy defeat in their Group A opening match in Jakarta.
details: Bangladesh suffered a disappointing start to the inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup 2026, losing 3-0 to Malaysia in their Group A opener today.
The match took place at the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta, Indonesia.
Malaysia's winger Arif Aiman scored a brace in the first half, putting the pressure on Thomas Dooley's side early on.
Forward Bergson added a third goal in the 52nd minute, sealing the victory for the Malaysian side.
The Bangladeshi team struggled to create any meaningful scoring opportunities throughout the match.
Bangladesh will next face Singapore at the same venue on September 28.
caption:
A tough start for the Red and Green. Bangladesh falls 3-0 to Malaysia in their ASEAN Cup opener.

Bangladesh suffered a disappointing start to the inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup 2026, losing 3-0 to Malaysia in their Group A opener today.

The match took place at the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta, Indonesia.

Malaysia's winger Arif Aiman scored a brace in the first half, putting the pressure on Thomas Dooley's side early on.

Forward Bergson added a third goal in the 52nd minute, sealing the victory for the Malaysian side.

The Bangladeshi team struggled to create any meaningful scoring opportunities throughout the match.

Bangladesh will next face Singapore at the same venue on September 28.

Source: Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, Prothom Alo
